# Pulse Internet Speed Test

> Pulse Internet Speed Test is a free Chrome extension that measures internet download speed, upload speed, ping and jitter in about 20 seconds from the browser toolbar, using Cloudflare's global speed-test network. It has no ads, needs no account and collects no personal data.

## Key facts
- Type: Chrome extension (Manifest V3); works in Chrome, Edge and Brave
- Price: free
- Measures: download (Mbps), upload (Mbps), ping (ms), jitter (ms)
- Test length: about 20 seconds (1 s ping, 9 s download, 9 s upload)
- Method: 12 ping samples (median); 5 parallel download streams; 3 parallel upload streams; first 30% of each phase excluded as ramp-up
- Server: speed.cloudflare.com, nearest of Cloudflare's 330+ city locations
- Privacy: last 20 results stored locally in the browser only; no analytics or tracking
- Author: Sohaib Saqib
